{{Top|leg}}
The '''Barpine Shipyards''' were a set of [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in the [[Barpine system/Legends|Barpine system]]. By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], they were under the control of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]-turned-[[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], [[Lon Donell]].
